headlines.title: Arsenal 'have ingredients' but Europe's elite on another level
headlines.description: In a difficult defeat by French giants Lyon, Arsenal were shown the gap they need to bridge to challenge for the Champions League.

headlines.title: Barcelona target Man Utd's Martinez - Friday's gossip
headlines.description: Barcelona interested in Lisandro Martinez, while Manchester United target Fulham defensive pair and Liverpool scout Serie A top scorer, plus more.

headlines.title: Lyon outclass Arsenal for Champions League win
headlines.description: Arsenal fall to a 2-0 defeat against a superior Lyon side in the Women's Champions League, dealing a blow to their hopes of automatic quarter-final qualification.
